title: What the Swift never lands for

is_this_you.pressure: Trouble on the ground sends you upward. You change altitude before anyone finishes the sentence.
is_this_you.love: Your love outlasts months of absence. Then you land back on the ledge where you left it, as if no time passed.
is_this_you.cost: People below hear you screaming overhead all summer and still ask where you have been.

opener.text: Heralds drew the martlet without feet, a bird modelled on swifts and martins and said never to roost from birth to death [s7]. It came to mark a fourth son who had to leave home and make his own way, though modern writers doubt that reading [s7]. You were born a Gemini in a Horse year. You know that crest from the inside.

tabs.label: Never landing
tabs.intro: Air feeding Fire, and nowhere to sit.

rows.text: Gemini is mutable Air under Mercury, a mind that keeps many threads going [s1] [s2]. The Horse is yang Fire, sociable and quick to take a risk [s3] [s4] [s5]. Air feeds Fire. Your mind outruns your body, and the body keeps up anyway.

Outside the breeding season a common swift stays airborne for about ten months, and some never land at all [s12]. It often sleeps and mates on the wing [s6]. Ground feels slow to you, so you spend as little time on it as you can.

The legend says the swift never rests. Tracking found that in spring nearly every tagged bird fed at a stopover in West Africa before the last leg home [s13]. You refuel the same way, briefly and out of sight, so people decide you never stop.

tabs.label: Your own way
tabs.intro: Gathered on the wing, glued fast at home.

rows.text: A swift builds from feathers and plant scraps caught in the air, bonded with its own saliva in a crevice [s6]. You build a life like that, gathered on the move and then fixed hard.
In cold, wet or windy weather swifts fly low, and in fair weather they climb high [s14]. When things go badly you come down close enough to touch, and your people get the most of you.
Gemini can spread itself thin, and the Horse dislikes taking orders [s2] [s4]. People are left unsure when you will be back. A return date said out loud settles a lot of nerves.
Correspondents, interpreters and flight crews all gather on the move and file from home. Any of them would suit you.

tabs.label: Who flies your sky
tabs.intro: Three who trust the return. One who wants you pinned down.
tabs.love_lead: In love you need someone who trusts the return. Swifts often come back to the same site and the same partner year after year [s6] [s14]. The old pairings name three who never ask you to land daily.

easy.why: The Luna Moth (Libra, Goat year) is your secret friend, since the Goat is the Horse's hidden ally, and Libra is Air like you [s3] [s1].
The Maned Wolf (Aquarius, Tiger year) carries the Tiger of your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Aquarius is a fellow Air sign [s3] [s1].
The Duetting Frog (Libra, Dog year) closes your trine with the Dog, and Libra gives you Air on both sides [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Sandgrouse (Sagittarius, Rat year): the Rat clashes with the Horse, and Sagittarius sits opposite Gemini [s3] [s1].

story.text: Beijing's swifts have nested on 正陽門 (Zhèngyáng Mén) for more than 600 years, by local account [s8]. Old Beijingers called them 樓燕 (lóuyàn), tower swallows [s8]. In 2008 the bird was the model for Nini, a Beijing Olympic mascot [s8] [s9]. Each July they leave for southern Africa, and still the gate gets them back [s8] [s9].

closing: Climb into the evening air and sleep up there. You have always been at home on the wing.
